unit.title: Who gets to stay after the film?
canDo: Evaluate a causal claim without dismissing useful observations
Discuss participation without forcing everyone to speak
Follow a longer account with proportions, sources and practical constraints

grammar.purpose: Attribute a source and reporting cutoff
grammar.explanation: 据 introduces the source; 截至 states a cutoff. Neither guarantees that all possible replies have been received.

examples.zh: 据记录，上周有十二个人留下。
examples.py: jù jì lù , shàng zhōu yǒu shí èr gè rén liú xià .
examples.en: The record says twelve stayed last week.

examples.zh: 截至周日晚，收到八份回复。
examples.py: jié zhì zhōu rì wǎn , shōu dào bā fèn huí fù .
examples.en: By Sunday evening eight replies had arrived.

commonMistakes.wrong: 截至周日晚收到八份，表示以后不会再收到。
commonMistakes.right: 截至周日晚，收到八份回复。
commonMistakes.why: A cutoff describes information so far, not all future responses.

grammar.purpose: Move to a related topic without accepting it
grammar.explanation: 至于 marks a topic shift. What follows may postpone, reject or discuss it.

examples.zh: 至于换主持人，这次还没有决定。
examples.py: zhì yú huàn zhǔ chí rén , zhè cì hái méi yǒu jué dìng .
examples.en: Changing hosts has not been decided.

examples.py: zhì yú chī shén me , nǐ men xiān xuǎn .
examples.en: As for food, you choose first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 至于换主持人，还没有决定，表示已经同意换。
commonMistakes.right: 至于换主持人，这次还没有决定。
commonMistakes.why: A topic shift is not approval.

grammar.purpose: Distinguish an additional reason from postponement
grammar.explanation: 再说 can add another reason, or with a time phrase postpone discussion. Context determines the function.

examples.zh: 再说，留下的人也不一定都开口。
examples.py: zài shuō , liú xià de rén yě bù yí dìng dōu kāi kǒu .
examples.en: Besides, not all who stay speak.

examples.py: nà jiàn shì míng tiān zài shuō .

commonMistakes.wrong: 那件事明天再说，表示现在已经决定不做。
commonMistakes.why: Postponing discussion is not necessarily refusal.

grammar.explanation: 不是…就… in a negated proposition denies that one fact necessarily yields another; retain the intended negation scope.

examples.zh: 不是先走了就表示没兴趣。
examples.py: bù shì xiān zǒu le jiù biǎo shì méi xìng qù .
examples.en: Leaving early does not automatically mean no interest.

examples.zh: 不是没人说话就表示没人在听。
examples.py: bù shì méi rén shuō huà jiù biǎo shì méi rén zài tīng .
examples.en: Silence does not automatically mean nobody is listening.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不是先走了就表示没兴趣，表示先走的人全有兴趣。
commonMistakes.right: 不是先走了就表示没兴趣。
commonMistakes.why: Rejecting a necessary connection does not establish its opposite for everyone.

grammar.purpose: Read a change with the same denominator
grammar.explanation: 8/20 is40%,12/20 is60%: an increase of20 percentage points or50% relative to8. These are different comparisons.

examples.zh: 百分之四十到百分之六十，增加二十个百分点。
examples.py: bǎi fēn zhī sì shí dào bǎi fēn zhī liù shí , zēng jiā èr shí gè bǎi fēn diǎn .

examples.zh: 八人到十二人，人数增加百分之五十。
examples.py: bā rén dào shí èr rén , rén shù zēng jiā bǎi fēn zhī wǔ shí .
examples.en: 8 to12 is a50% relative count increase.

commonMistakes.wrong: 八人变十二人，人数增加二十个人。
commonMistakes.right: 八人到十二人，人数增加百分之五十。
commonMistakes.why: The count increases by four, not twenty.

grammar.purpose: Keep more than one reason in view
grammar.explanation: A related additional factor can follow 还. This does not assign each factor an equal measured contribution.

examples.zh: 两次不只主持人不同，结束时间还不同。
examples.py: liǎng cì bù zhǐ zhǔ chí rén bù tóng , jié shù shí jiān hái bù tóng .
examples.en: The host and finishing time both differed.

examples.zh: 她不只想聊天，还想赶上车。
examples.py: tā bù zhǐ xiǎng liáo tiān , hái xiǎng gǎn shàng chē .
examples.en: She wants to chat and catch the bus.

commonMistakes.wrong: 两次有两个变化，表示它们各贡献一半。
commonMistakes.right: 两次不只主持人不同，结束时间还不同。
commonMistakes.why: Listing factors does not measure their shares.

dialogue.title: 电影散场以后
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你看群里那句了吗？换个主持人，大家就都愿意聊了。
lines.py: nǐ kàn qún lǐ nà jù le ma ? huàn gè zhǔ chí rén , dà jiā jiù dōu yuàn yì liáo le .
lines.en: Did you see that line in the group—change hosts and everyone will want to talk?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 说得也太满了吧。上周那部片本来就好聊。
lines.py: shuō de yě tài mǎn le ba . shàng zhōu nà bù piàn běn lái jiù hǎo liáo .
lines.en: That's a bit sweeping. Last week's film was easy to talk about anyway.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 可是留下的人真多了。
lines.py: kě shì liú xià de rén zhēn duō le .
lines.en: But more people really did stay.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 多了，不等于全是主持人的功劳。你上次为什么先走？
lines.py: duō le , bù děng yú quán shì zhǔ chí rén de gōng láo . nǐ shàng cì wèi shén me xiān zǒu ?
lines.en: More stayed, but the host needn't get all the credit. Why did you leave early last time?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 说实话，我怕错过末班车。
lines.py: shuō shí huà , wǒ pà cuò guò mò bān chē .
lines.en: Honestly, I was worried about the last bus.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对啊，你又不是讨厌讨论。
lines.py: duì a , nǐ yòu bù shì tǎo yàn tǎo lùn .
lines.en: Right—you weren't avoiding discussion.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我是不是也不能说大家没兴趣？
lines.py: nà wǒ shì bú shì yě bù néng shuō dà jiā méi xìng qù ?
lines.en: Then I shouldn't say people aren't interested either?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先问问嘛。有的人听得挺认真，就是不爱抢着说。
lines.py: xiān wèn wèn ma . yǒu de rén tīng de tǐng rèn zhēn , jiù shì bù ài qiǎng zhe shuō .
lines.en: Ask first. Some people listen carefully but don't like jumping in.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我就是。有人一开口就停不下来。
lines.py: wǒ jiù shì . yǒu rén yī kāi kǒu jiù tíng bù xià lái .
lines.en: That's me. Some people get going and never stop.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你看我干吗？我今天还没说完三句话。
lines.py: nǐ kàn wǒ gàn má ? wǒ jīn tiān hái méi shuō wán sān jù huà .
lines.en: Why are you looking at me? I've barely finished three sentences today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 现在第四句了。
lines.py: xiàn zài dì sì jù le .
lines.en: That makes four now.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，留点时间给你。你想怎么试？
lines.py: xíng , liú diǎn shí jiān gěi nǐ . nǐ xiǎng zěn me shì ?
lines.en: Fine, I'll leave some time for you. What would you try?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 先给大家一分钟想，再聊十五分钟。
lines.py: xiān gěi dà jiā yī fēn zhōng xiǎng , zài liáo shí wǔ fēn zhōng .
lines.en: Give everyone a minute to think, then discuss for fifteen minutes.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 问题提前交，现场也能补一条？
lines.py: wèn tí tí qián jiāo , xiàn chǎng yě néng bǔ yī tiáo ?
lines.en: Submit questions in advance, with another allowed on the day?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 可以。想听的就听，不必每个人轮流讲。
lines.py: kě yǐ . xiǎng tīng de jiù tīng , bù bì měi gè rén lún liú jiǎng .
lines.en: Sure. People can just listen; no need to make everyone speak in turn.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 但要不要给没开口的人留个机会？
lines.py: dàn yào bù yào gěi méi kāi kǒu de rén liú gè jī huì ?
lines.en: But should we leave an opportunity for people who haven't spoken?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 问一句有没有人想补充，不点名。
lines.py: wèn yī jù yǒu méi yǒu rén xiǎng bǔ chōng , bù diǎn míng .
lines.en: Ask if anyone wants to add something, without naming anyone.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 上周二十个人看，十二个人留，对吧？
lines.py: shàng zhōu èr shí gè rén kàn , shí èr gè rén liú , duì ba ?
lines.en: Twenty watched and twelve stayed last week, right?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对。前一周也是二十个，八个留。
lines.py: duì . qián yī zhōu yě shì èr shí gè , bā gè liú .
lines.en: Right. The week before, twenty watched and eight stayed.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那就是多二十个百分点，不能说多二十个人。
lines.py: nà jiù shì duō èr shí gè bǎi fēn diǎn , bù néng shuō duō èr shí gè rén .
lines.en: So that's twenty percentage points more, not twenty more people.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这回算对了。别把你的四句话也算成百分比。

reading.title: 电影散场以后
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 散场后，走廊里还有几个人在争论电影的结尾。我想留下听，却一直盯着手机上的车次。主持人问我是不是不喜欢这部片，我说喜欢，只是回家要换一次车。他很快回了一句那下次选早点的场吧，我才松口气。以前群里讨论为什么有人总先走，大家常把原因猜成电影太难、气氛不热，或者那个人不爱说话。轮到我自己，原因却简单得很：最后一班车不会因为结尾好看就等我。
lines.py: sàn chǎng hòu , zǒu láng lǐ hái yǒu jǐ gè rén zài zhēng lùn diàn yǐng de jié wěi . wǒ xiǎng liú xià tīng , què yì zhí dīng zhe shǒu jī shàng de chē cì . zhǔ chí rén wèn wǒ shì bú shì bù xǐ huān zhè bù piàn , wǒ shuō xǐ huān , zhǐ shì huí jiā yào huàn yī cì chē . tā hěn kuài huí le yī jù nà xià cì xuǎn zǎo diǎn de chǎng ba , wǒ cái sōng kǒu qì . yǐ qián qún lǐ tǎo lùn wèi shén me yǒu rén zǒng xiān zǒu , dà jiā cháng bǎ yuán yīn cāi chéng diàn yǐng tài nán , qì fēn bù rè , huò zhě nà gè rén bù ài shuō huà . lún dào wǒ zì jǐ , yuán yīn què jiǎn dān de hěn : zuì hòu yī bān chē bù huì yīn wèi jié wěi hǎo kàn jiù děng wǒ .
lines.en: After the film, people debated the ending in the corridor. I wanted to listen but kept checking the bus. The host asked whether I disliked the film. I liked it; I needed to change buses. His suggestion of an earlier screening reassured me. The group had guessed people left because films were difficult, the atmosphere was dull or they disliked talking. My own reason was simpler: the last bus would not wait for a good ending.

lines.zh: 后来群里有人说，换主持人以后，留下的人从八个变成十二个，所以新主持人的办法明显更好。我翻了两次记录，两场都是二十人看电影，数字没写错。可是前一场周日晚十点才散，后一场周六九点结束；前一部片长一些，后一部片的结尾又特别容易引起讨论。主持人确实也换了，还提前发了三个问题。看见人数上升很高兴，但这么多地方一起变了，要挑出哪一个起了作用，单靠这两行人数可不够。
lines.py: hòu lái qún lǐ yǒu rén shuō , huàn zhǔ chí rén yǐ hòu , liú xià de rén cóng bā gè biàn chéng shí èr gè , suǒ yǐ xīn zhǔ chí rén de bàn fǎ míng xiǎn gèng hǎo . wǒ fān le liǎng cì jì lù , liǎng chǎng dōu shì èr shí rén kàn diàn yǐng , shù zì méi xiě cuò . kě shì qián yī chǎng zhōu rì wǎn shí diǎn cái sàn , hòu yī chǎng zhōu liù jiǔ diǎn jié shù ; qián yī bù piàn zhǎng yī xiē , hòu yī bù piàn de jié wěi yòu tè bié róng yì yǐn qǐ tǎo lùn . zhǔ chí rén què shí yě huàn le , hái tí qián fā le sān gè wèn tí . kàn jiàn rén shù shàng shēng hěn gāo xìng , dàn zhè me duō dì fāng yì qǐ biàn le , yào tiāo chū nǎ yī gè qǐ le zuò yòng , dān kào zhè liǎng xíng rén shù kě bù gòu .
lines.en: Someone later credited the new host for increasing those who stayed from eight to twelve. Both screenings had twenty viewers; the counts were correct. But one ended Sunday at ten and the other Saturday at nine. Film lengths and endings differed too, and the new host sent three questions beforehand. The increase was welcome, but two counts could not isolate one cause among all the changes.

lines.zh: 陈宇问我，那新主持人到底做得怎么样。我说很喜欢他上次那个问题：在哪一刻改变了对主角的看法。我一下就想起车站那场戏，也想听旁边的人怎么说。陈宇说他也是，不过刚才在群里写得太急，把大家都愿意聊放了进去。他打开手机，改成自己很想继续那场讨论，又问我要不要一起报名。我说先看看结束时间，别又聊到赶不上车。
lines.py: chén yǔ wèn wǒ , nà xīn zhǔ chí rén dào dǐ zuò de zěn me yàng . wǒ shuō hěn xǐ huān tā shàng cì nà gè wèn tí : zài nǎ yī kè gǎi biàn le duì zhǔ jué de kàn fǎ . wǒ yī xià jiù xiǎng qǐ chē zhàn nà chǎng xì , yě xiǎng tīng páng biān de rén zěn me shuō . chén yǔ shuō tā yě shì , bù guò gāng cái zài qún lǐ xiě de tài jí , bǎ dà jiā dōu yuàn yì liáo fàng le jìn qù . tā dǎ kāi shǒu jī , gǎi chéng zì jǐ hěn xiǎng jì xù nà chǎng tǎo lùn , yòu wèn wǒ yào bù yào yì qǐ bào míng . wǒ shuō xiān kàn kàn jié shù shí jiān , bié yòu liáo dào gǎn bù shàng chē .
lines.en: Chen Yu asked what I thought of the new host. I loved his question about when our view of the protagonist changed; it brought back the station scene, and I wanted others' reactions. Chen did too, but he'd hastily written that everyone wanted to talk. He changed his message to his own wish to continue, then asked if I'd sign up. First check the finish time, I said, so I wouldn't miss the bus again.

lines.zh: 我建议先用两场小范围试点，不换掉常规放映。选定讨论的结束时间，问题提前收一条，现场留一分钟让人想，再开放十五分钟自由讨论。只想听的人可以不说，主持人中间问一次还有没有人想补充，不点名催答案。这样我不用一边开口一边看车，也不会因为沉默被当成没认真看。陈宇答应负责记人数，但我们又加了一项：散场后给愿意回复的人一个短问题，问时间和讨论方式是不是方便。
lines.py: wǒ jiàn yì xiān yòng liǎng chǎng xiǎo fàn wéi shì diǎn , bù huàn diào cháng guī fàng yìng . xuǎn dìng tǎo lùn de jié shù shí jiān , wèn tí tí qián shōu yī tiáo , xiàn chǎng liú yī fēn zhōng ràng rén xiǎng , zài kāi fàng shí wǔ fēn zhōng zì yóu tǎo lùn . zhǐ xiǎng tīng de rén kě yǐ bù shuō , zhǔ chí rén zhōng jiān wèn yī cì hái yǒu méi yǒu rén xiǎng bǔ chōng , bù diǎn míng cuī dá àn . zhè yàng wǒ bù yòng yī biān kāi kǒu yī biān kàn chē , yě bù huì yīn wèi chén mò bèi dàng chéng méi rèn zhēn kàn . chén yǔ dā yìng fù zé jì rén shù , dàn wǒ men yòu jiā le yī xiàng : sàn chǎng hòu gěi yuàn yì huí fù de rén yī gè duǎn wèn tí , wèn shí jiān hé tǎo lùn fāng shì shì bú shì fāng biàn .
lines.en: I proposed two small pilot events alongside normal screenings: a fixed end, one advance question, a minute to think and fifteen minutes of discussion. Listening without speaking would be allowed. The host would invite additions without putting individuals on the spot. That let me speak without watching the bus and listen without my silence being mistaken for inattention. Chen Yu would record attendance; willing respondents could also answer a short question about timing and format.

lines.zh: 第一场结束，十五个人里有九个留下，其中四个只听。陈宇差点只记五个参与讨论，我提醒他我们没有规定开口才算参加。九个人里，七个回复了那个短问题；有两个人说时间合适，一个人说问题太多，希望只留一个，另外四个人没有提时间。我们把这些意见写在一起，没有让七份回复替没回复的人说话。下一场仍然按约好的十五分钟结束，只把提前的问题减到一个，看看大家能不能把一件事聊得更完整。
lines.py: dì yī chǎng jié shù , shí wǔ gè rén lǐ yǒu jiǔ gè liú xià , qí zhōng sì gè zhǐ tīng . chén yǔ chà diǎn zhǐ jì wǔ gè cān yù tǎo lùn , wǒ tí xǐng tā wǒ men méi yǒu guī dìng kāi kǒu cái suàn cān jiā . jiǔ gè rén lǐ , qī gè huí fù le nà gè duǎn wèn tí ; yǒu liǎng gè rén shuō shí jiān hé shì , yī gè rén shuō wèn tí tài duō , xī wàng zhǐ liú yī gè , lìng wài sì gè rén méi yǒu tí shí jiān . wǒ men bǎ zhè xiē yì jiàn xiě zài yì qǐ , méi yǒu ràng qī fèn huí fù tì méi huí fù de rén shuō huà . xià yī chǎng réng rán àn yuē hǎo de shí wǔ fēn zhōng jié shù , zhǐ bǎ tí qián de wèn tí jiǎn dào yī gè , kàn kàn dà jiā néng bù néng bǎ yī jiàn shì liáo de gèng wán zhěng .
lines.en: At the first pilot, nine of fifteen viewers stayed, including four who only listened. Chen Yu nearly recorded just five participants; speaking was not our definition of participation. Seven of the nine answered the short question. Two liked the timing, one wanted only one question, and four did not mention timing. We kept the responses without speaking for nonrespondents. The next event retained fifteen minutes but reduced advance questions to one, allowing fuller discussion of one issue.

lines.zh: 第二次我坐到了前面。陈宇看见我，笑说你终于不准备随时逃跑了。我说还是准备回家，只是现在不用逃。他把椅子挪开一点，让后来的人也能坐进来。讨论开始时，那个平时话很少的朋友先说了车站那场戏，我们没有急着接上自己的观点。她讲到一半停了，想了想，又补了一个细节。我那天记得最清楚的不是人数，而是那几秒没人催她的空白。回家的车仍然得赶，想留下的时间却终于有了位置。
lines.py: dì èr cì wǒ zuò dào le qián miàn . chén yǔ kàn jiàn wǒ , xiào shuō nǐ zhōng yú bù zhǔn bèi suí shí táo pǎo le . wǒ shuō hái shi zhǔn bèi huí jiā , zhǐ shì xiàn zài bù yòng táo . tā bǎ yǐ zi nuó kāi yī diǎn , ràng hòu lái de rén yě néng zuò jìn lái . tǎo lùn kāi shǐ shí , nà gè píng shí huà hěn shǎo de péng you xiān shuō le chē zhàn nà chǎng xì , wǒ men méi yǒu jí zhe jiē shàng zì jǐ de guān diǎn . tā jiǎng dào yí bàn tíng le , xiǎng le xiǎng , yòu bǔ le yī gè xì jié . wǒ nà tiān jì de zuì qīng chǔ de bù shì rén shù , ér shì nà jǐ miǎo méi rén cuī tā de kòng bái . huí jiā de chē réng rán děi gǎn , xiǎng liú xià de shí jiān què zhōng yú yǒu le wèi zhì .
lines.en: At the second pilot I sat nearer the front. Chen Yu joked I was finally not ready to flee. I still wanted to get home; I no longer needed to flee. He moved a chair to make space. A usually quiet friend began with the station scene. We didn't rush to add our views. She paused, thought and supplied another detail. My clearest memory was not a count but those unhurried seconds. I still had a bus to catch, but time for staying finally had a place.

lines.zh: 我们想探讨散场后要不要留下聊天。

lines.zh: 她愿意听取不同的建议。

lines.zh: 两次活动的差异不只有主持人。

lines.zh: 我不觉得一次冷场就能看出活动的本质。

lines.zh: 别把外观当成本质。

lines.zh: 这次讨论的核心是怎样让人愿意留下。

lines.en: First identify the article's central question.

lines.zh: 讨论人数跟留下的人数有关联，但不一定说明原因。
lines.py: tǎo lùn rén shù gēn liú xià de rén shù yǒu guān lián , dàn bù yí dìng shuō míng yuán yīn .
lines.en: Discussion participation and staying are connected, but that needn't explain the cause.

lines.zh: 这段话和前一段有什么关联？
lines.py: zhè duàn huà hé qián yī duàn yǒu shén me guān lián ?
lines.en: How is this paragraph connected to the previous one?

lines.zh: 据主持人的记录，上周有十二个人留下。
lines.py: jù zhǔ chí rén de jì lù , shàng zhōu yǒu shí èr gè rén liú xià .
lines.en: According to the host's record, twelve people stayed last week.

lines.zh: 据她说，活动已经换了场地。
lines.py: jù tā shuō , huó dòng yǐ jīng huàn le chǎng dì .
lines.en: According to her, the event has changed venues.

lines.zh: 截至周日晚，收到八份回复。
lines.py: jié zhì zhōu rì wǎn , shōu dào bā fèn huí fù .
lines.en: By Sunday evening, eight replies had arrived.

lines.zh: 截至今天，报名的人数还没变。
lines.py: jié zhì jīn tiān , bào míng de rén shù hái méi biàn .
lines.en: As of today, the registration count hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 百分之四十到百分之六十，增加二十个百分点。
lines.py: bǎi fēn zhī sì shí dào bǎi fēn zhī liù shí , zēng jiā èr shí gè bǎi fēn diǎn .
lines.en: Forty to sixty percent is an increase of twenty percentage points.

lines.zh: 这个比例下降了五个百分点。
lines.py: zhè gè bǐ lì xià jiàng le wǔ gè bǎi fēn diǎn .
lines.en: This proportion fell by five percentage points.

lines.zh: 不能只用发言次数衡量参与。
lines.py: bù néng zhǐ yòng fā yán cì shù héng liáng cān yù .
lines.en: Participation cannot be assessed solely by how often someone speaks.

lines.zh: 她用完成的任务衡量进展。
lines.py: tā yòng wán chéng de rèn wù héng liáng jìn zhǎn .
lines.en: She assesses progress through completed tasks.

lines.zh: 我倾向于先试一个短一点的讨论。
lines.py: wǒ qīng xiàng yú xiān shì yī gè duǎn yī diǎn de tǎo lùn .
lines.en: I lean towards trying a shorter discussion first.

lines.zh: 他倾向于下午出门。
lines.py: tā qīng xiàng yú xià wǔ chū mén .
lines.en: He tends to go out in the afternoon.

lines.zh: 小组采纳了先给一分钟想的建议。
lines.py: xiǎo zǔ cǎi nà le xiān gěi yī fēn zhōng xiǎng de jiàn yì .
lines.en: The group adopted the suggestion of a minute to think first.

lines.zh: 不是每条建议都会被采纳。
lines.py: bù shì měi tiáo jiàn yì dū huì bèi cǎi nà .
lines.en: Not every suggestion will be adopted.

lines.zh: 这两场只是小范围试点。
lines.py: zhè liǎng chǎng zhǐ shì xiǎo fàn wéi shì diǎn .
lines.en: These two events are only a small pilot.

lines.zh: 试点结束以后再决定是否继续。
lines.py: shì diǎn jié shù yǐ hòu zài jué dìng shì fǒu jì xù .
lines.en: Decide whether to continue after the pilot ends.

lines.zh: 常规放映仍然保留。
lines.py: cháng guī fàng yìng réng rán bǎo liú .
lines.en: The usual screenings remain.

lines.zh: 这不属于常规安排。
lines.py: zhè bù shǔ yú cháng guī ān pái .
lines.en: This isn't part of the usual arrangement.

lines.zh: 我们需要切实的安排，不只是一句多聊聊。
lines.py: wǒ men xū yào qiè shí de ān pái , bù zhǐ shì yī jù duō liáo liáo .
lines.en: We need a practical plan, not merely 'talk more'.

lines.zh: 她提出了一个切实的办法。
lines.py: tā tí chū le yī gè qiè shí de bàn fǎ .
lines.en: She proposed a practical solution.

lines.zh: 能否延长讨论，还要问场馆。
lines.py: néng fǒu yán cháng tǎo lùn , hái yào wèn chǎng guǎn .
lines.en: Whether discussion can be extended still needs checking with the venue.

lines.zh: 我想确认能否带朋友来。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng què rèn néng fǒu dài péng you lái .
lines.en: I'd like to confirm whether I can bring a friend.

lines.zh: 周日晚回家太晚对我不便。
lines.py: zhōu rì wǎn huí jiā tài wǎn duì wǒ bù biàn .
lines.en: Getting home too late on Sunday is inconvenient for me.

lines.zh: 现在不便通话，晚点联系。
lines.py: xiàn zài bù biàn tōng huà , wǎn diǎn lián xì .
lines.en: A call is inconvenient now; let's talk later.

lines.zh: 至于换主持人，这次还没有决定。
lines.py: zhì yú huàn zhǔ chí rén , zhè cì hái méi yǒu jué dìng .
lines.en: As for changing the host, that hasn't been decided.

lines.zh: 至于吃什么，你们先选。
lines.py: zhì yú chī shén me , nǐ men xiān xuǎn .
lines.en: As for what to eat, you choose first.

lines.zh: 再说，留下的人也不一定每个都开口。
lines.py: zài shuō , liú xià de rén yě bù yí dìng měi gè dōu kāi kǒu .
lines.en: Besides, not everyone who stays necessarily speaks.

lines.zh: 那件事明天再说。
lines.py: nà jiàn shì míng tiān zài shuō .
lines.en: Let's discuss that tomorrow.

lines.zh: 就是说，我们只知道这两次的人数不同。
lines.py: jiù shì shuō , wǒ men zhǐ zhī dào zhè liǎng cì de rén shù bù tóng .
lines.en: That is, we only know attendance differed on these two occasions.

lines.zh: 你的意思就是说先等回复？
lines.py: nǐ de yì si jiù shì shuō xiān děng huí fù ?
lines.en: You mean we should wait for a reply first?

lines.zh: 换了主持人会不会更好，很难说。
lines.py: huàn le zhǔ chí rén huì bù huì gèng hǎo , hěn nán shuō .
lines.en: It's hard to say whether changing hosts would help.

lines.zh: 她周末能不能来，很难说。
lines.py: tā zhōu mò néng bù néng lái , hěn nán shuō .
lines.en: It's hard to say whether she can come this weekend.

lines.zh: 说实话，我上次只是怕错过末班车。
lines.py: shuō shí huà , wǒ shàng cì zhǐ shì pà cuò guò mò bān chē .
lines.en: To be honest, I was just afraid of missing the last bus.

lines.zh: 说实话，这个结尾我没看懂。
lines.py: shuō shí huà , zhè gè jié wěi wǒ méi kàn dǒng .
lines.en: To be honest, I didn't understand the ending.

lines.zh: 先让她说完，别急着打断。
lines.py: xiān ràng tā shuō wán , bié jí zhe dǎ duàn .
lines.en: Let her finish before interrupting.

lines.zh: 电话打断了我们的谈话。
lines.py: diàn huà dǎ duàn le wǒ men de tán huà .
lines.en: A phone call interrupted our conversation.

lines.zh: 别让一个人占据全部讨论时间。
lines.py: bié ràng yī gè rén zhàn jù quán bù tǎo lùn shí jiān .
lines.en: Don't let one person take up all the discussion time.

lines.zh: 书占据了桌子的大部分地方。
lines.py: shū zhàn jù le zhuō zi de dà bù fèn dì fāng .
lines.en: Books occupy most of the table.

lines.zh: 没人马上回应，不一定是没有兴趣。
lines.py: méi rén mǎ shàng huí yìng , bù yí dìng shì méi yǒu xìng qù .
lines.en: No immediate response doesn't necessarily mean no interest.

lines.zh: 她回应了关于地点的问题。
lines.py: tā huí yìng le guān yú dì diǎn de wèn tí .
lines.en: She responded to the question about location.

lines.zh: 每个人可以提交一条问题。
lines.py: měi gè rén kě yǐ tí jiāo yī tiáo wèn tí .
lines.en: Everyone can submit one question.

lines.zh: 我已经提交了申请。
lines.py: wǒ yǐ jīng tí jiāo le shēn qǐng .
lines.en: I've submitted the application.

lines.zh: 主持人向小组通报新的散场时间。
lines.py: zhǔ chí rén xiàng xiǎo zǔ tōng bào xīn de sàn chǎng shí jiān .
lines.en: The host told the group the new finishing time.

lines.zh: 负责人通报了临时调整。
lines.py: fù zé rén tōng bào le lín shí tiáo zhěng .
lines.en: The organiser announced the temporary change.

lines.zh: 场馆十点关门，不能聊到十一点。
lines.py: chǎng guǎn shí diǎn guān mén , bù néng liáo dào shí yī diǎn .
lines.en: The venue closes at ten, so we can't talk until eleven.

lines.zh: 这个场馆周日开放。
lines.py: zhè gè chǎng guǎn zhōu rì kāi fàng .
lines.en: This venue opens on Sunday.

lines.zh: 讨论名额和放映名额分别计算。
lines.py: tǎo lùn míng é hé fàng yìng míng é fēn bié jì suàn .
lines.en: Discussion places and screening places are counted separately.

lines.zh: 这次还有两个名额。
lines.py: zhè cì hái yǒu liǎng gè míng é .
lines.en: Two places are still available this time.

lines.zh: 最终决定等试点结束再做。
lines.py: zuì zhōng jué dìng děng shì diǎn jié shù zài zuò .
lines.en: The final decision will wait until the pilot ends.

lines.zh: 我们最终选了周六下午。
lines.py: wǒ men zuì zhōng xuǎn le zhōu liù xià wǔ .
lines.en: We finally chose Saturday afternoon.

lines.zh: 把结束时间写清，免得大家错过车。
lines.py: bǎ jié shù shí jiān xiě qīng , miǎn de dà jiā cuò guò chē .
lines.en: Write the finish time clearly so people don't miss their bus.

lines.zh: 我先发消息，免得她白跑。
lines.py: wǒ xiān fā xiāo xī , miǎn de tā bái pǎo .
lines.en: I'll message first so she doesn't make a wasted trip.

extraReadings.title: The host learns to pause
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 我接手电影小组的时候，最担心的是散场后的讨论。放映安排清楚，大家买好票、找好座位，片子开始就能坐下来；讨论却没有这样的边界。有时我问了一个问题，三个人同时开口，另一些人连想插话的地方都找不到。有时谁都不说，我就忍不住把问题讲得越来越长，最后听起来像是我又讲了一遍电影。活动结束以后很累，却仍然不知道那些一直点头的人究竟有没有得到自己想要的东西。
lines.py: wǒ jiē shǒu diàn yǐng xiǎo zǔ de shí hou , zuì dān xīn de shì sàn chǎng hòu de tǎo lùn . fàng yìng ān pái qīng chǔ , dà jiā mǎi hǎo piào , zhǎo hǎo zuò wèi , piān zi kāi shǐ jiù néng zuò xià lái ; tǎo lùn què méi yǒu zhè yàng de biān jiè . yǒu shí wǒ wèn le yī gè wèn tí , sān gè rén tóng shí kāi kǒu , lìng yī xiē rén lián xiǎng chā huà de dì fāng dōu zhǎo bù dào . yǒu shí shéi dōu bù shuō , wǒ jiù rěn bú zhù bǎ wèn tí jiǎng de yuè lái yuè zhǎng , zuì hòu tīng qǐ lái xiàng shì wǒ yòu jiǎng le yī biàn diàn yǐng . huó dòng jié shù yǐ hòu hěn lèi , què réng rán bù zhī dào nà xiē yì zhí diǎn tóu de rén jiū jìng yǒu méi yǒu dé dào zì jǐ xiǎng yào de dōng xi .
lines.en: When I took over the film group, discussion worried me most. Screening had clear boundaries: tickets, seats and a start. Discussion did not. Sometimes three people spoke at once while others couldn't join. Sometimes silence made me keep expanding a question until I was retelling the film. I finished tired and still unsure whether quiet listeners had got what they wanted.

lines.zh: 有一次大家留下得多，群里很快有人夸我比前一个主持人强。我看见很高兴，又有点不好意思。前一个人把场地、设备和报名都交代得很清楚，只是最后那场结束晚了。我知道林安要换车，另一个朋友第二天要早起，不能把他们先走都算到主持人的头上。而且我选的电影短一些，结尾留下一个很明显的问题。若说这次活动有几个安排值得继续试，我愿意；若说一切都是换了我才改善，我自己也说不出口。
lines.py: yǒu yī cì dà jiā liú xià de duō , qún lǐ hěn kuài yǒu rén kuā wǒ bǐ qián yī gè zhǔ chí rén qiáng . wǒ kàn jiàn hěn gāo xìng , yòu yǒu diǎn bù hǎo yì sī . qián yī gè rén bǎ chǎng dì , shè bèi hé bào míng dōu jiāo dài de hěn qīng chǔ , zhǐ shì zuì hòu nà chǎng jié shù wǎn le . wǒ zhī dào lín ān yào huàn chē , lìng yī gè péng you dì èr tiān yào zǎo qǐ , bù néng bǎ tā men xiān zǒu dōu suàn dào zhǔ chí rén de tóu shàng . ér qiě wǒ xuǎn de diàn yǐng duǎn yī xiē , jié wěi liú xià yī gè hěn míng xiǎn de wèn tí . ruò shuō zhè cì huó dòng yǒu jǐ gè ān pái zhí de jì xù shì , wǒ yuàn yì ; ruò shuō yī qiè dōu shì huàn le wǒ cái gǎi shàn , wǒ zì jǐ yě shuō bù chū kǒu .
lines.en: When more stayed, someone praised me over the previous host. I was pleased but uneasy. The previous person had organised venue, equipment and registrations well; the final screening merely ended late. Lin An needed a bus connection and someone else an early start. My film was shorter and had a clear open question. I could support trying parts of the arrangement again, but couldn't credit all improvement to replacing the host with me.

lines.zh: 我们后来把试点写成一张很短的说明，放映仍按原来的方式进行，讨论另算名额，因为小房间坐不下所有看电影的人。愿意留下的可以在报名时勾一下，想先听也行。结束时间写九点四十五，场馆十点关门。陈宇看了看中间的十五分钟，我让他试着收完这些椅子，再检查设备。他走了一圈回来，说明白了，这段还真不能拿来继续聊。
lines.py: wǒ men hòu lái bǎ shì diǎn xiě chéng yī zhāng hěn duǎn de shuō míng , fàng yìng réng àn yuán lái de fāng shì jìn xíng , tǎo lùn lìng suàn míng é , yīn wèi xiǎo fáng jiān zuò bù xià suǒ yǒu kàn diàn yǐng de rén . yuàn yì liú xià de kě yǐ zài bào míng shí gōu yī xià , xiǎng xiān tīng yě xíng . jié shù shí jiān xiě jiǔ diǎn sì shí wǔ , chǎng guǎn shí diǎn guān mén . chén yǔ kàn le kàn zhòng jiān de shí wǔ fēn zhōng , wǒ ràng tā shì zhe shōu wán zhè xiē yǐ zi , zài jiǎn chá shè bèi . tā zǒu le yī quān huí lái , shuō míng bái le , zhè duàn hái zhēn bù néng ná lái jì xù liáo .
lines.en: Our short notice kept the usual screening, with separate discussion places because the small room couldn't seat everyone. People could sign up to stay, including just to listen. Discussion ended at 9:45 and the venue closed at ten. Chen looked at the fifteen-minute gap. I asked him to try putting away the chairs and checking equipment; after a circuit of the room he agreed we couldn't use that time for more conversation.

lines.zh: 第一场我给一分钟想问题，房间里忽然很安静，我差点又补一大段解释。陈宇冲我摆了摆手，我才想起这段安静本来就是留出来的。后来有人开口，我没有急着问第二个问题，而是请愿意的人接着说同一个场景。一个朋友说自己只想听，我说可以，又问全场有没有别的人想补充。她听到最后，走前跟我说刚才那种停一下的感觉很好。我第一次发现，主持人不一直说，讨论也并没有因此停下来。
lines.py: dì yī chǎng wǒ gěi yī fēn zhōng xiǎng wèn tí , fáng jiān lǐ hū rán hěn ān jìng , wǒ chà diǎn yòu bǔ yī dà duàn jiě shì . chén yǔ chōng wǒ bǎi le bǎi shǒu , wǒ cái xiǎng qǐ zhè duàn ān jìng běn lái jiù shì liú chū lái de . hòu lái yǒu rén kāi kǒu , wǒ méi yǒu jí zhe wèn dì èr gè wèn tí , ér shì qǐng yuàn yì de rén jiē zhe shuō tóng yī gè chǎng jǐng . yī gè péng you shuō zì jǐ zhǐ xiǎng tīng , wǒ shuō kě yǐ , yòu wèn quán chǎng yǒu méi yǒu bié de rén xiǎng bǔ chōng . tā tīng dào zuì hòu , zǒu qián gēn wǒ shuō gāng cái nà zhǒng tíng yī xià de gǎn jué hěn hǎo . wǒ dì yī cì fā xiàn , zhǔ chí rén bù yì zhí shuō , tǎo lùn yě bìng méi yǒu yīn cǐ tíng xià lái .
lines.en: At the first pilot, the minute for thinking was so quiet I almost added another explanation. Chen Yu waved, reminding me silence was planned. Once someone spoke, I didn't rush to a second question but invited thoughts on the same scene. Someone wanted just to listen; that was fine. I invited additions from the room. Afterwards she liked the pauses. I realised discussion didn't stop when its host wasn't constantly talking.

lines.zh: 记录的时候我们保留了看电影、留下和开口三个数字。第一场十五人看、九人留、五人说，这些数字说的是不同的事，不能挑最大一个叫作发言人数，也不能挑最小一个说只有五个人喜欢活动。短问题有七份回复，我看见其中两人说时间方便，不能改写成所有九个人都同意。有人希望提前问题少些，我很愿意采纳，因为自己也发现三个问题挤在十五分钟里太赶。下一次减到一个，说明里仍然让人知道可以现场补充。
lines.py: jì lù de shí hou wǒ men bǎo liú le kàn diàn yǐng , liú xià hé kāi kǒu sān gè shù zì . dì yī chǎng shí wǔ rén kàn , jiǔ rén liú , wǔ rén shuō , zhè xiē shù zì shuō de shì bù tóng de shì , bù néng tiāo zuì dà yī gè jiào zuò fā yán rén shù , yě bù néng tiāo zuì xiǎo yī gè shuō zhǐ yǒu wǔ gè rén xǐ huān huó dòng . duǎn wèn tí yǒu qī fèn huí fù , wǒ kàn jiàn qí zhōng liǎng rén shuō shí jiān fāng biàn , bù néng gǎi xiě chéng suǒ yǒu jiǔ gè rén dōu tóng yì . yǒu rén xī wàng tí qián wèn tí shǎo xiē , wǒ hěn yuàn yì cǎi nà , yīn wèi zì jǐ yě fā xiàn sān gè wèn tí jǐ zài shí wǔ fēn zhōng lǐ tài gǎn . xià yī cì jiǎn dào yī gè , shuō míng lǐ réng rán ràng rén zhī dào kě yǐ xiàn chǎng bǔ chōng .
lines.en: We retained separate counts: fifteen watched, nine stayed and five spoke. These measured different things, neither nine speakers nor only five who liked the event. Seven replies included two favourable timing comments, not agreement from all nine. A request for fewer advance questions matched my own sense that three in fifteen minutes was rushed. We reduced them to one while allowing additions on the day.
